implementation: Added m-model evaluate --run <id> with explicit --evaluator and --data entrypoints, split/sample target, evaluator/data parameters and optional declared data fingerprint.
Evaluation accepts arbitrary model return structures and only reports evaluator-owned named finite scalar metrics; no classification assumption is introduced.

Only completed/failed/interrupted training runs with a valid latest checkpoint can be evaluated. The worker verifies checkpoint manifest/file/model-state hashes, reuses the run model/injection/variant snapshot, and rejects source drift before model construction.

Results are persisted as separate evaluation run records and reference source run, checkpoint digest/step, evaluator/data entrypoints, data parameters, split/seed/fingerprint, loaded source manifest and protocol/runtime versions.

Reported sample counts are checked against the requested target; unreported counts remain unknown. Invalid/non-finite metrics, missing metrics/data and incompatible checkpoint conditions return structured diagnostics.
Registered the evaluate operation and training.evaluation capability in Rust/Python protocol contracts, doctor, embedded assets and operation documentation.
Added CLI-22 to track the remaining human-facing evaluation overview and sample/prediction browsing flow.
